text:
Roe v. Wade is highly controversial because the Court recognized a constitutional right to abortion and sharply limited state bans. Supporters treat that holding as protection of bodily autonomy, while opponents treat it as authorizing the ending of unborn life and as an unenumerated right created through substantive due process rather than constitutional text and history. That dispute structured American politics for fifty years, until Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization overruled Roe in 2022 and returned abortion regulation to elected legislatures.

CONFIDENCE: 92
